Remark
[Higher-order ambient metric stability] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0296 ↗ lem:chow-iv-hypersurface-geometry-ambient-metric-stability ↗ lem:chow-iv-hypersurface-intrinsic-curvature-stability 1. ch34:34.21\group Hyperbolic Almost Isometries

For $k\ge 1$, the corresponding $k$-th derivatives of the second fundamental forms are controlled by $C_k\| \widetilde g-g\| _{C^{k+1}}$, and the $k$-th derivatives of the intrinsic curvature tensors are controlled by $C_k\| \widetilde g-g\| _{C^{k+2}}$. The same statements hold when the hypersurface is a boundary component.
